goal: 顺利通过答辩委员会的提问环节,用同义替换策略清晰作答并获得认可

n1.speaker: 答辩主席 Prof. Wilson
n1.line: Welcome, Ms. Chen. To begin with, could you summarise the central argument of your thesis in your own words?
n1.lineCn: 欢迎你,陈同学。首先,你能用自己的话概括一下论文的核心论点吗?

grammar.name: In your own words
grammar.note: 答辩经典指令:要求考生用自己的话重述 (paraphrase) 论文要点,考察是否真正理解而非背诵。

options.text: Certainly. My thesis argues that community-based language programmes foster retention more effectively than conventional classroom instruction.
options.textCn: 当然。我的论文主张:社区型语言项目比传统课堂教学更能有效提高语言保持率。
options.feedback: 用 foster、retention 等学术词替换原题表述,重述完整且用词考究。

options.text: My thesis is about language programmes and how they help people remember languages better than classes do.
options.textCn: 我的论文讲的是语言项目,以及它们怎么比上课更能帮人记住语言。
options.feedback: 意思对,但 remember、help、classes 太口语,答辩需要学术化的同义替换。

options.text: It is basically the same as what I wrote in the abstract, so I do not think I need to say it again.
options.textCn: 这和我摘要里写的差不多,我觉得没必要再说一遍。
options.feedback: 回避提问显得态度不端,主席明确提醒你必须正面作答。

n2.speaker: 答辩委员 Dr. Patel
n2.line: Your thesis examines the effect of community programmes on retention. In what sense does your study differ from prior work in this field?
n2.lineCn: 你的论文考察社区项目对语言保持的影响。你的研究与先前同类研究有何不同?

grammar.name: Prior work / previous studies
grammar.note: 同义替换策略之一:用 prior work、earlier research、existing literature 轮换表达“先前研究”,避免重复。

options.text: Unlike earlier research, which relied on self-reported data, my study incorporates longitudinal test results spanning eighteen months.
options.textCn: 与依赖自我报告数据的早期研究不同,我的研究纳入了长达十八个月的纵向测验数据。
options.feedback: 用 unlike 对比加 eighteen months 具体证据,差异化表述清晰有力。

options.text: My study is different because I did something new that nobody did before.
options.textCn: 我的研究不同,因为我做了以前没人做过的新东西。
options.feedback: “做了新东西”空泛无据,评委无法判断差异所在,要求你具体说明。

options.text: I am not familiar with prior work, so I cannot really compare my study with theirs.
options.textCn: 我对先前研究不熟悉,所以没法真正比较。
options.feedback: 答辩前不了解文献综述是致命弱点,委员会无法信任你的研究定位。

n3.speaker: 答辩主席 Prof. Wilson
n3.line: I would encourage you to rephrase the argument more formally, using the academic vocabulary you are expected to command at this level.
n3.lineCn: 我建议你用更正式的方式重述论点,使用这个层次应掌握的学术词汇。

grammar.name: I would encourage you to...
grammar.note: 评委给出建议的委婉句式:would + 动词原形弱化指令感,比 you should 更符合答辩场合。

options.text: I appreciate the guidance. To be precise, my thesis contends that community-based programmes outperform conventional instruction in sustaining language acquisition.
options.textCn: 感谢指点。准确地说,我的论文主张:社区项目在维持语言习得方面优于传统教学。
options.feedback: 用 contends、outperform、sustaining 完成漂亮的同义替换,重新进入正题。

options.text: Okay, so my paper talks about community stuff that makes language stick better than normal teaching.
options.textCn: 好吧,我论文就是讲社区那点事儿能让语言记得更牢,比普通教学强。
options.feedback: stuff、stick 等口语词汇再次出现,完全无视学术语体要求。

options.text: I am afraid I cannot think of a more formal way to say it at the moment.
options.textCn: 恐怕我一时想不出更正式的说法。
options.feedback: 承认自己无法替换表述,等于暴露词汇和改写能力不足。

n4.speaker: 答辩委员 Dr. Ito
n4.line: You repeatedly describe your results as "significant". Could you specify precisely which findings proved significant, and in what statistical sense?
n4.lineCn: 你反复把结果描述为“显著”。你能明确说明哪些发现显著,以及是何种统计意义上的显著吗?

grammar.name: Specify precisely
grammar.note: 评委追问时常用的精确化要求:specify + 副词 precisely/clearly,迫使考生把模糊用词 (significant) 落到实处。

options.text: By significant, I mean statistically significant at the 0.05 level; specifically, the retention gap between the two cohorts proved significant in the second semester.
options.textCn: 我所说的显著指 0.05 水平的统计显著;具体而言,两个队列在第二学期的保持差距达到显著水平。
options.feedback: 主动澄清 ambiguous 术语并给出具体数据,同义替换的典范回应。

options.text: Significant just means important. My results were important because they showed improvement.
options.textCn: 显著就是重要的意思。我的结果很重要,因为它们显示了进步。
options.feedback: 把统计术语当日常用语,概念混淆会让委员会质疑你的方法学功底。

options.text: I should clarify: the term refers to statistical significance, though I concede the effect size is modest.
options.textCn: 我应澄清:该词指统计显著性,不过我承认效应量偏小。
options.feedback: 定义准确且主动补充效应量信息,体现严谨的自我修正。

n5.speaker: 答辩委员 Dr. Patel
n5.line: Allow me to rephrase my earlier question: what novel contribution does your study make that earlier investigations have not made?
n5.lineCn: 请允许我换个说法重述刚才的问题:与早先的研究相比,你的研究做出了什么新的贡献?

grammar.name: Allow me to rephrase
grammar.note: 评委示范同义替换的标准句式:先明确告知 rephrase,再换一套词汇重问,考生应学习这种改写习惯。

options.text: Thank you for the clarity. The novel contribution lies in linking retention outcomes to learners' community engagement, which earlier studies largely overlooked.
options.textCn: 谢谢您说得更清楚。新的贡献在于把保持效果与学习者的社区参与联系起来,而早先研究大多忽视了这一点。
options.feedback: 紧扣 novel contribution 作答,overlook 等高级替换词运用到位。

options.text: I still do not understand the question, to be honest.
options.textCn: 老实说,我还是没听懂这个问题。
options.feedback: 两次追问后仍无法理解,暴露出听力与应变能力不足。

options.text: The contribution is that I connected retention with engagement, something not examined in depth before.
options.textCn: 我的贡献是我把保持和参与联系了起来,这是以前没深入考察过的。
options.feedback: 回答基本到位,若再用 linked to、prior to 等词会更正式。

n6.speaker: 答辩委员 Dr. Ito
n6.line: Turning to practical implications, what recommendations would you draw from your findings for language educators?
n6.lineCn: 谈到实际意义,你从研究结果中为语言教育者提出了哪些建议?

grammar.name: Practical implications
grammar.note: 答辩高频追问点:implications (影响、启示) 与 recommendations (建议) 常成对出现,表述时应区分二者。

options.text: One key recommendation is that educators should integrate community-based practice into curricula, as our data indicate it markedly strengthens retention.
options.textCn: 一项关键建议是:教育者应将社区实践融入课程,因为数据表明它能显著增强语言保持。
options.feedback: 建议具体、因果清晰,把学术发现落到教学实践,符合委员会的期待。

options.text: Teachers should just do more community stuff because it works.
options.textCn: 老师就该多做点社区活动,因为有用。
options.feedback: just、stuff、works 高度口语化,且缺乏数据支撑,说服力不足。

options.text: I would suggest, on the basis of the evidence, that institutions allocate resources towards community-based initiatives rather than extending classroom hours.
options.textCn: 基于证据,我建议机构把资源投向社区型项目,而非延长课堂课时。
options.feedback: 基于证据的表述 (on the basis of the evidence) 让建议更有分量。

n7.speaker: 答辩主席 Prof. Wilson
n7.line: No research is without limitations. Which weaknesses of your study would you yourself acknowledge?
n7.lineCn: 任何研究都有局限。你愿意承认自己研究的哪些不足?

grammar.name: No research is without limitations
grammar.note: 双重否定句式:not... without... 表示“无不……”,是学术表达中增加深度的替换手段。

options.text: I acknowledge that the sample was drawn from a single city, which may limit generalisability; future studies could replicate the design in other regions.
options.textCn: 我承认样本取自单一城市,可能限制可推广性;未来研究可在其他地区重复该设计。
options.feedback: 坦诚局限并给出对策,是答辩中最加分的一类回答。

options.text: My study has no real weaknesses, since I followed every standard procedure carefully.
options.textCn: 我的研究没什么真正的弱点,因为我每一步都严格按标准程序来。
options.feedback: 声称毫无缺陷既不可信也缺乏学术反思,委员会印象分大减。

options.text: A limitation is the relatively brief observation window, though the eighteen-month design partly mitigates this concern.
options.textCn: 局限之一是观察窗口较短,不过十八个月的设计在一定程度上缓解了这一担忧。
options.feedback: 指出局限并说明缓解措施,平衡得体,展现了成熟的批判性思维。

n8.speaker: 答辩主席 Prof. Wilson
n8.line: Before we conclude, is there anything you would like to add regarding the future directions of your research?
n8.lineCn: 在结束之前,关于研究未来的方向,你有什么想补充的吗?

grammar.name: Future directions
grammar.note: “未来研究方向”是论文结尾与答辩收尾的高频搭配,常与 extend, explore, investigate 连用。

options.text: Yes. I hope to extend the study to rural communities, and to explore how tutor-led mentoring interacts with community-based learning.
options.textCn: 有。我希望把研究扩展到农村社区,并探索导师辅导与社区学习之间的交互作用。
options.feedback: 方向明确、动词地道 (extend, explore),为研究画上漂亮的省略号。

options.text: I guess I will see what happens next, depending on whether I find a job.
options.textCn: 我猜接下来看情况吧,取决于我找不找得到工作。
options.feedback: 把学术规划说得随意含糊,与答辩的严肃氛围格格不入。

options.text: I plan to investigate the longitudinal stability of the effects, and to test whether they persist beyond a two-year horizon.
options.textCn: 我计划考察这些效应的纵向稳定性,并检验它们在两年之后是否依然持续。
options.feedback: 研究规划具体严谨,委员会对你的科研潜力印象深刻。

success.speaker: 答辩主席 Prof. Wilson
success.line: The committee is satisfied with your responses. Congratulations, Ms. Chen, your thesis passes with distinction.
success.lineCn: 委员会对你的回答很满意。恭喜你,陈同学,你的论文以优秀成绩通过。

grammar.name: Pass with distinction
grammar.note: 固定搭配:pass with distinction 表示“以优异成绩通过”,distinction 此处为名词“优异”。

fail1.speaker: 答辩主席 Prof. Wilson
fail1.line: Thank you for your presentation. The committee would ask you to revise the thesis in line with the written comments you will receive.
fail1.lineCn: 感谢你的陈述。委员会要求你按照稍后收到的书面意见修改论文。

grammar.name: In line with
grammar.note: 介词短语 in line with 表示“与……一致、按照……”,比 following 更书面,是同义替换的好素材。

fail2.speaker: 答辩委员 Dr. Ito
fail2.line: I am afraid the committee remains unconvinced on several methodological points. We shall deliberate on the outcome.
fail2.lineCn: 恐怕委员会在几个方法论要点上仍无法信服。我们将对结果进行评议。

grammar.name: Remain unconvinced
grammar.note: remain + 形容词表示“仍然处于某状态”,unconvinced 比 not persuaded 更凝练,典型同义替换。
